mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 78 degrees. Tonight features a first quarter moon, and space fans should look to the northwest near Verona High School at 9:33 PM to watch the ISS travel toward Fitchburg for six minutes.

The City of Verona keeps us connected via VHAT on channel 989 or YouTube. Also, please remember that if you store recreational vehicles, they must be in designated spaces at least five feet from property lines to stay in compliance with city code.
The coming days are packed in Verona. We have trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Louie on July 21, followed by the Downtown Farmer's Market and Yoga at Insight Wellness on July 22.
Looking at the weekly service reports, on July 16, officers encountered a neighbor dispute on West Verona Avenue that resulted in an arrest for criminal trespass.

Today is the perfect day to treat yourself to our flavor of the day, Chocolate Caramel Twist. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to head over, and tomorrow you can look forward to the Mint Explosion.
